about: Phone-only WebP crops of journal banners (5 Nov 2026, owner-approved). Originals are untouched.
Each variant is the source resized exactly as its existing srcset tier was (Lanczos, same width and height), then cut to the rows phones can see.

Rows phones see: the banner is object-fit: cover in a box from 320px to 736px wide; the narrowest box aspect (narrowestPhoneAspect, measured in Chromium) shows the tallest band, width / aspect rows. The crop keeps margin times that band.
The crop top is (height - cropHeight) * objectPositionY, an exact integer, so the same object-position frames every phone width exactly as the full tier does.

Quality: the lowest WebP quality from 80 (the banners' WebP standard) whose SSIM against the same region of a lossless Lanczos resize of the original is at least the existing tier's (baselineSsim; for the full-width tier, the -1200 tier's).
make-responsive-variants.py --phone-banners checks these boxes and writes any missing <stem>-phone-<width>.webp; the build emits a (max-width: 736px) <source> only when every srcset tier has one.
